summary: Tested 5 booking enhancements: (1) Auto-checkout expired bookings, (2) Past-date validation, (3) iCal source tracking, (4) Source filter dropdown, (5) Source display. All 11 backend tests PASSED. All frontend features verified working.
passed_tests: Backend: test_02_past_date_booking_rejected - POST /api/bookings returns 400 for past check-in dates
Backend: test_03_today_booking_accepted - POST /api/bookings accepts today's check-in date
Backend: test_04_future_booking_accepted - POST /api/bookings accepts future check-in dates
Backend: test_05_manual_booking_has_ota_source - Manual bookings have ota_source='manual'
Backend: test_06_get_bookings_sources_endpoint - GET /api/bookings/sources returns source list
Backend: test_08_auto_checkout_in_list_bookings - GET /api/bookings auto-updates expired to checked_out
Backend: test_09_booking_list_contains_ota_source - Bookings include ota_source field
Backend: test_10_checkout_before_checkin_rejected - Invalid date ranges rejected with 400
Frontend: Source filter dropdown present in list view
Frontend: Source column header exists in booking table
Frontend: 70 source badges displayed (Airbnb, Direct, Expedia, etc.)
Frontend: Source filter 'Direct Booking' works correctly
Frontend: Check-in date input has min='2026-02-22' attribute (today's date)
Frontend: Booking detail popup shows Source field with badge

auto_checkout_status.details: GET /api/bookings auto-updates expired bookings (check_out < today) from confirmed/checked_in to checked_out. Also runs on app startup and periodic task every hour.

past_date_validation.details: POST /api/bookings returns 400 with message 'Check-in date cannot be in the past' for past dates. Frontend check-in input has min attribute set to today.

ical_source_tracking.details: Bookings have ota_source field. Manual bookings get ota_source='manual'. iCal imports get airbnb/booking.com/etc.

source_filter_dropdown.details: Source filter dropdown in list view with options: All Sources, Direct Booking, Airbnb, Booking.Com, Expedia, Vrbo

source_display.details: Source column in booking table shows badges. Booking detail popup shows Source with badge. Direct/manual bookings show 'Direct', iCal imports show platform name.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 booking enhancements are working correctly. Auto-checkout runs on startup and periodically. Source tracking differentiates between manual/direct bookings and OTA imports. Frontend has source filter and displays sources in table and detail popup.
